description: Source code for the SI7055 temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for initialization, temperature reading, and sensor data handling.

methods.name: si7055_get_temperature
methods.description: Reads temperature data from the SI7055 sensor via I2C, with optional checksum verification.

methods.name: si7055_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a temperature sample from the sensor.

methods.name: si7055_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the temperature value in sensor_value format for supported channels.

methods.name: si7055_init
methods.description: Initializes the SI7055 sensor device, checking I2C bus readiness.
